module

public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Rank

@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

/-- Abstract data of the collapse used in Paper 16 `lem:tower-cofinality`:
an index order (the paper's uncountable arguments), a value order (the
countable ordinals), the collapse `psi`, the coefficient norm, the class of
`N_B`-critical values, the value `one`, the endpoint `Λ` and the tower
arguments `a_n`. Nothing here is defined concretely. -/
structure CollapseData (I : Type u) (O : Type v) where
  psi : I → O
  norm : I → O
  critical : O → Prop
  one : O
  endpoint : I
  a : ℕ → I

variable {I : Type u} {O : Type v} [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O]

/-- The characterization (P) cited from Simmons 2004, Section 5: `psi ξ` is
the least critical `θ` such that `η < ξ` and `|η| < θ` imply `psi η < θ`. -/
def CharacterizationP (D : CollapseData I O) : Prop :=
  ∀ ξ : I, D.critical (D.psi ξ) ∧
    (∀ η, η < ξ → D.norm η < D.psi ξ → D.psi η < D.psi ξ) ∧
    ∀ θ, D.critical θ → (∀ η, η < ξ → D.norm η < θ → D.psi η < θ) → D.psi ξ ≤ θ

/-- Everything the printed proof of `lem:tower-cofinality` uses besides
order reasoning: (P); the tower arguments increase, lie below the endpoint
and are cofinal in it; `|a_n| ≤ 1`; critical values exceed one; and a least
upper bound of a strictly increasing sequence of critical values is
critical ("the countable supremum is therefore an N_B-critical ordinal"). -/
structure TowerHypotheses (D : CollapseData I O) : Prop where
  characterization : CharacterizationP D
  increasing : ∀ n, D.a n < D.a (n + 1)
  below : ∀ n, D.a n < D.endpoint
  cofinal : ∀ η, η < D.endpoint → ∃ n, η < D.a n
  normBound : ∀ n, D.norm (D.a n) ≤ D.one
  criticalAboveOne : ∀ θ, D.critical θ → D.one < θ
  criticalSup : ∀ f : ℕ → O, StrictMono f → (∀ n, D.critical (f n)) →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range f) θ → D.critical θ

/-- `lem:tower-cofinality`, first equality, conditional on the cited
inputs: the supremum of the collapse values along the tower is the collapse
at the endpoint. The supremum is any least upper bound. -/
def ConditionalTowerSupremum : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O),
    TowerHypotheses D →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))) θ → θ = D.psi D.endpoint

/-- The collapse values along the tower are strictly increasing (the
first step of the printed proof). -/
def ConditionalTowerIncreasing : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O),
    TowerHypotheses D → StrictMono (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))

/-- The full printed lemma: with the cited identification of the endpoint
value with `BH` (Pohlers, Sections 9.4–9.5) as one more hypothesis. -/
def ConditionalTowerCofinality : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O] (D : CollapseData I O) (BH : O),
    TowerHypotheses D → D.psi D.endpoint = BH →
    ∀ θ, IsLUB (Set.range (fun n => D.psi (D.a n))) θ → θ = D.psi D.endpoint ∧ θ = BH

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinality

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalTowerCofinalityTargets

@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniqueness
open ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

/-- The characterization (P) determines the collapse: on a well-founded
index order, two collapses with the same coefficient norm and the same
critical class that both satisfy (P) are the same function. So (P) is a
legitimate defining clause ("this particular collapse"), and any function
satisfying it is the collapse. Existence is not claimed here. -/
def CharacterizationDeterminesCollapse : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [WellFoundedLT I] [LinearOrder O]
    (D D' : CollapseData I O), D.norm = D'.norm → D.critical = D'.critical →
    CharacterizationP D → CharacterizationP D' → D.psi = D'.psi

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniqueness

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniquenessTargets

public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniqueness
open ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

theorem characterizationDeterminesCollapse : CharacterizationDeterminesCollapse.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ _ D D' hn hc hP hP'
  funext ξ
  refine WellFoundedLT.induction (motive := fun ξ => D.psi ξ = D'.psi ξ) ξ ?_
  intro ξ ih
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (hP ξ).2.2 (D'.psi ξ)
    · rw [hc]
      exact (hP' ξ).1
    · intro η hη hnorm
      rw [ih η hη]
      have hnorm' : D'.norm η < D'.psi ξ := by
        rw [← hn]
        exact hnorm
      exact (hP' ξ).2.1 η hη hnorm'
  · apply (hP' ξ).2.2 (D.psi ξ)
    · rw [← hc]
      exact (hP ξ).1
    · intro η hη hnorm
      rw [← ih η hη]
      have hnorm' : D.norm η < D.psi ξ := by
        rw [hn]
        exact hnorm
      exact (hP ξ).2.1 η hη hnorm'

#print axioms characterizationDeterminesCollapse
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniqueness

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseUniquenessTargets

@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseExistence
open ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

/-- Solvability of the defining clause of (P): whatever values `prev` have
been assigned, some critical `θ` satisfies the clause at `ξ`. Here `prev` is
a total function; only its values below `ξ` are used. -/
def Solvable {I : Type u} {O : Type v} [LT I] [LT O]
    (norm : I → O) (critical : O → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ξ : I) (prev : I → O), ∃ θ, critical θ ∧ ∀ η, η < ξ → norm η < θ → prev η < θ

/-- The same hypothesis with `prev` given only below `ξ` (a dependent
function). -/
def SolvableBelow {I : Type u} {O : Type v} [LT I] [LT O]
    (norm : I → O) (critical : O → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ξ : I) (prev : (η : I) → η < ξ → O),
    ∃ θ, critical θ ∧ ∀ η (h : η < ξ), norm η < θ → prev η h < θ

/-- Existence for (P): on a well-founded index order with a well-ordered
value order, solvability of the clause gives a collapse satisfying (P). The
fields `one`, `endpoint`, `a` do not occur in (P) and are arbitrary. Together
with `CharacterizationDeterminesCollapse` (#1484) this makes (P) a definition.
Solvability itself is a hypothesis; it is not established here for any
concrete notation system. -/
def CharacterizationExists : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [WellFoundedLT I] [LinearOrder O]
    [WellFoundedLT O] (norm : I → O) (critical : O → Prop) (one : O) (endpoint : I)
    (a : ℕ → I), Solvable norm critical →
    ∃ psi : I → O, CharacterizationP ⟨psi, norm, critical, one, endpoint, a⟩

/-- Existence from the dependent form of the hypothesis. -/
def CharacterizationExistsBelow : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [WellFoundedLT I] [LinearOrder O]
    [WellFoundedLT O] (norm : I → O) (critical : O → Prop) (one : O) (endpoint : I)
    (a : ℕ → I), SolvableBelow norm critical →
    ∃ psi : I → O, CharacterizationP ⟨psi, norm, critical, one, endpoint, a⟩

/-- The two forms of the hypothesis are equivalent: a partial `prev` below
`ξ` extends to a total one (by `norm ξ` elsewhere), so the dependent form is
not actually weaker. -/
def SolvableIffSolvableBelow : Prop :=
  ∀ (I : Type u) (O : Type v) [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder O]
    (norm : I → O) (critical : O → Prop),
    Solvable norm critical ↔ SolvableBelow norm critical

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseExistence

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseExistenceTargets

public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseExistence
open ConditionalTowerCofinality

universe u v

theorem solvableIffSolvableBelow : SolvableIffSolvableBelow.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ norm critical
  constructor
  · intro hs ξ prev
    obtain ⟨θ, hc, h⟩ := hs ξ (fun η => if h : η < ξ then prev η h else norm ξ)
    refine ⟨θ, hc, fun η hη hn => ?_⟩
    have h' := h η hη hn
    simpa [hη] using h'
  · intro hs ξ prev
    exact hs ξ (fun η _ => prev η)

theorem characterizationExistsBelow : CharacterizationExistsBelow.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ _ _ norm critical one endpoint a hs
  -- the least critical value satisfying the clause for given earlier values
  have hmin : ∀ (ξ : I) (prev : (η : I) → η < ξ → O),
      ∃ θ, (critical θ ∧ ∀ η (h : η < ξ), norm η < θ → prev η h < θ) ∧
        ∀ θ', (critical θ' ∧ ∀ η (h : η < ξ), norm η < θ' → prev η h < θ') → θ ≤ θ' := by
    intro ξ prev
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hleast⟩ := (wellFounded_lt (α := O)).has_min
      {θ | critical θ ∧ ∀ η (h : η < ξ), norm η < θ → prev η h < θ} (hs ξ prev)
    exact ⟨θ, hθ, fun θ' hθ' => not_lt.mp (hleast θ' hθ')⟩
  choose F hF hFmin using hmin
  -- well-founded recursion on the index
  obtain ⟨psi, hpsi⟩ : ∃ psi : I → O, ∀ ξ, psi ξ = F ξ (fun η _ => psi η) :=
    ⟨WellFounded.fix (C := fun _ => O) (wellFounded_lt (α := I)) F,
      fun ξ => WellFounded.fix_eq (C := fun _ => O) (wellFounded_lt (α := I)) F ξ⟩
  refine ⟨psi, fun ξ => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hF ξ (fun η _ => psi η)
  have h2 := hFmin ξ (fun η _ => psi η)
  rw [← hpsi ξ] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2, fun θ hc hθ => h2 θ ⟨hc, hθ⟩⟩

theorem characterizationExists : CharacterizationExists.{u,v} := by
  intro I O _ _ _ _ norm critical one endpoint a hs
  exact characterizationExistsBelow.{u,v} I O norm critical one endpoint a
    ((solvableIffSolvableBelow.{u,v} I O norm critical).mp hs)

#print axioms solvableIffSolvableBelow
#print axioms characterizationExistsBelow
#print axioms characterizationExists
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.ConditionalCollapseExistence
